using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Diagnostics.CodeAnalysis;
using System.Threading;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Amazon.BedrockRuntime;
using Amazon.BedrockRuntime.Model;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging.Abstractions;
using Microsoft.SemanticKernel;
using Microsoft.SemanticKernel.ChatCompletion;
using Microsoft.SemanticKernel.Connectors.Amazon.Core;
using Microsoft.SemanticKernel.Connectors.Amazon.Core.Clients;
using Moq;
using Xunit;

public class BedrockChatCompletionClientTests
{
    [Fact]
    public async Task StreamChatMessageAsync_LogsError_OnException()
    {
        // Arrange
        var mockLogger = new Mock<ILogger<BedrockChatCompletionClient>>();
        var mockBedrockRuntime = new Mock<IAmazonBedrockRuntime>();
        var modelId = "test-model-id";

        mockBedrockRuntime
            .Setup(x => x.ConverseStreamAsync(It.IsAny<ConverseStreamRequest>(), It.IsAny<CancellationToken>()))
            .ThrowsAsync(new InvalidOperationException("Test exception"));

        var mockServiceFactory = new Mock<BedrockServiceFactory>();
        mockServiceFactory.Setup(x => x.CreateChatCompletionService(modelId)).Returns(Mock.Of<IBedrockChatCompletionService>());
        mockServiceFactory.Setup(x => x.GetModelProviderAndName(modelId)).Returns((new BedrockModelProviderAndName { modelProvider = "test-provider" }, ""));

        // Create client using reflection to inject logger and service factory
        var client = CreateClientWithLogger(modelId, mockBedrockRuntime.Object, mockLogger.Object, mockServiceFactory.Object);

        var chatHistory = new ChatHistory();
        chatHistory.AddUserMessage("test");

        // Act & Assert
        var exception = await Assert.ThrowsAnyAsync<Exception>(() => CollectAsyncEnumerable(client.StreamChatMessageAsync(chatHistory)));

        // Verify LogError was called with correct parameters
        mockLogger.Verify(
            x => x.LogError(
                It.IsAny<Exception>(),
                "Can't converse stream with '{ModelId}'. Reason: {Error}",
                modelId,
                "Test exception"),
            Times.Once);
    }

    private static async Task CollectAsyncEnumerable<T>(IAsyncEnumerable<T> enumerable)
    {
        await foreach (var _ in enumerable)
        {
        }
    }

    private static BedrockChatCompletionClient CreateClientWithLogger(
        string modelId,
        IAmazonBedrockRuntime bedrockRuntime,
        ILogger logger,
        Mock<BedrockServiceFactory> serviceFactory)
    {
        // Use reflection to set private _ioChatService field since constructor uses internal service factory
        var client = new BedrockChatCompletionClient(modelId, bedrockRuntime, NullLoggerFactory.Instance);
        
        // Replace logger field via reflection
        typeof(BedrockChatCompletionClient)
            .GetField("_logger", System.Reflection.BindingFlags.NonPublic | System.Reflection.BindingFlags.Instance)
            ?.SetValue(client, logger);

        // Replace _ioChatService field via reflection  
        typeof(BedrockChatCompletionClient)
            .GetField("_ioChatService", System.Reflection.BindingFlags.NonPublic | System.Reflection.BindingFlags.Instance)
            ?.SetValue(client, serviceFactory.Object.Object.CreateChatCompletionService(modelId));

        return client;
    }
}
